fixture.notes: Boots a real WildFly 32 distribution under rust-jvm via jboss-modules.jar (NOT JPMS). The first-failure baseline below is a best-guess from JBoss Modules architecture and the known rust-jvm gaps in waves 1-7 — to be replaced with the actual stderr signature once the parent runs the harness once.

steps.name: stage
steps.notes: stage.sh / stage.ps1 download wildfly-32.0.1.Final.tar.gz to .cache/, validate sha256, extract under staged/wildfly/. Idempotent.

steps.name: run
steps.notes: run-under-rustjvm.{sh,ps1} invokes rustjvm --jar staged/wildfly/jboss-modules.jar -mp staged/wildfly/modules org.jboss.as.standalone --server-config=standalone.xml. Boot is killed by TIMEOUT_SEC (default 60) — most-likely outcome is a JBoss Modules clinit / SPI failure long before 'WFLYSRV0025: WildFly Full ... started in Nms' is emitted.

first_failure_hypothesis.most_likely: java.lang.NoSuchMethodError or NPE inside org.jboss.modules.Main.<clinit> or org.jboss.modules.ModuleLoader, while parsing the first module.xml under staged/wildfly/modules/system/layers/base/. Most plausible exact site: ServiceLoader-driven discovery of org.jboss.modules.ModuleLoader providers, or a java.util.logging.LogManager initialization race when Djava.util.logging.manager=org.jboss.logmanager.LogManager forces JBoss LogManager to be installed before java.base finishes bootstrap.
alternates: URLClassPath/URLClassLoader path while resolving file: URLs to module .jars — known WP1.8 / Wave 7 surface area.
java.nio.channels.FileChannel.map for memory-mapped reads (h2 / log files) — WP3.3 partial.
Thread.getContextClassLoader being null inside a clinit before jboss-modules has finished installing its bootstrap loader.

Module.getResources('META-INF/services/...') returning empty because the rust-jvm classpath only contains jboss-modules.jar and not the system modules — by design, JBoss Modules walks modules/ at runtime, so this should be OK after WP1.8.

known_blockers.summary: Pin the actual first-failure stderr signature here once run-under-rustjvm.sh has been executed once on a real machine. Replace `expected_stderr_contains` with the precise NoSuchMethodError class+method or the exception qualified name. Bump `generated_at`.

ServiceLoader.discover_providers must scan via ctx.find_all_resource_urls — confirmed landed (see roadmap §16). Re-verify under WildFly's ModuleLoader SPI which uses ServiceLoader.load(ModuleFinder.class).
FileChannel.map partial — WildFly's H2 datasource and jboss-logmanager file appender both touch FileChannel APIs. Watch for UnsupportedOperationException on map/transferTo/lock.

history.blocker: WP8.10 first-failure hypothesis only — no real boot run yet. expected_stderr_contains pinned to the conservative 'JBoss Modules' substring (banner) so diff-baseline passes only if rust-jvm gets at least far enough to emit the JBoss Modules header line.

definition_of_pass: Long-term: rc=0 + 'WFLYSRV0025' in stdout + a reachable :9990 admin console. Short-term: rc matches expected_final_rc and stderr contains the pinned first-failure marker (no regression past it).
update_policy: Update this file as soon as the first real run produces a concrete first-failure. Each new failure surfaced + fixed should bump generated_at, move the previous failure into history[], and pin the next-most-distant failure as the new expected_stderr_contains target. Total expected updates: 5-30 across the WP8.10 lifecycle (each round is a 1-3 hr fix in some Wave 1-7 WP).
